role.roleTitle: Software Engineer, Mine Fleet Dispatch System

evidence.text: Dispatch software engineer at a mining company from 2021 to 2025, delivering algorithm and interface work for the fleet dispatch system against the mine operations specialists' specifications under the dispatch software standard.

Carried the pager on the dispatch on-call rota for the whole four years across the three control rooms; the on-call log lists fifty-two night calls under my name, nine of them stopped-fleet incidents, each with the time to restore and the control room's sign-off that the fleet was moving again.
Every change of mine went through the mine simulator before review, with the simulator record filed against the change and countersigned by a second engineer.
Changes went through dispatch software review and out on the dispatch software lead's approval, which the change record shows next to the checks that were mine.
Behind every change there is a boundary and hand-over note in the change record's closure section, stating what the change does not cover.
